patch_list: Every "watch an ad" button pays out immediately without playing an ad: the main-menu gift grants 100 diamonds and the in-level revive button revives you. Works offline. The gift can be claimed repeatedly — the cooldown and availability che…

Every shop button grants its item directly instead of opening Google Play billing: Remove Ads and the four diamond packs (1 / 2 / 5 / 10). No payment sheet appears, the grant runs the game's own success handler, and the purchase is saved n…

Removes every ad from the game: banners, interstitials, the app-open ad and the rewarded-video prompts are all suppressed in native code, so the ad SDK is never asked to display anything. Works offline and needs no purchase.
